summary: P2 Session Verification — Selfie Check feature fully tested. All 16 tests passed covering: selfie submission by trainer/trainee, both-verified flow, validation rules (<100 chars rejected, >5MB rejected), access control (403 for non-participants), verification status endpoint with timestamps, and data storage in session_selfies collection.

frontend_issues.note: Frontend testing skipped - React Native/Expo app not testable via Playwright

critical_code_review_comments: SelfieVerifyRequest model (line 2307-2308): Simple model with selfieBase64 field as expected

verify_selfie endpoint (lines 2310-2393): Correctly validates session participation (403), selfie size (100-7M chars), stores in session_selfies with role/timestamp, updates session flags, notifies other party
get_verification_status endpoint (lines 2396-2418): Returns trainerVerified, traineeVerified, bothVerified flags with timestamps (trainerSelfieAt, traineeSelfieAt)
Selfie truncation (line 2352): Base64 data truncated to first 200 chars + '...' for storage efficiency - GOOD PRACTICE
Upsert behavior (line 2346-2357): Uses update_one with upsert=True to avoid duplicates on resubmission - CORRECT
Notification sent to other party (lines 2377-2386): Fire-and-forget push notification when selfie is submitted
seed_data_creation: Test sessions created directly in MongoDB with status='confirmed' for each test, cleaned up after each test
context_for_next_testing_agent: P2 Selfie Verification fully tested. Key verified flows: (1) POST /api/sessions/{id}/verify-selfie - trainer submits selfie, returns role='trainer', bothVerified=false, (2) trainee submits after trainer, bothVerified=true, session.selfieVerificationComplete=true, (3) Validation: <100 chars → 400, >5MB (7M chars) → 400, empty → 400, (4) Access control: non-participant → 403 for both submit and status, unauthenticated → 401/403, (5) GET /api/sessions/{id}/verification-status returns trainerVerified, traineeVerified, bothVerified with timestamps, (6) Data stored in session_selfies collection with role, verifiedAt, truncated selfieBase64, (7) Session document updated with trainerSelfieVerified, traineeSelfieVerified, selfieVerificationComplete flags. Rate limiting active: 10/min for login - use module-scoped fixtures to reuse tokens.
